name: cardgame-site-embeds-composited-card-art
title: Show composited card art on the design-shelf site's card pages
pitch: tools/build-site.js renders every design/cards/*.md page as plain markdown text; extend it to embed each card's composited SVG render from renders/cards-composited/ next to that card's heading, so the phone-browsable design shelf actually shows the card instead of raw rules text.
why_now: T16's second named want is a website to browse the design shelf from the phone ("I need to be able to see what we got without going over to my computer and picking through files and folders"); tools/build-site.js and tools/serve-site.js already shipped that site, and tools/composite-card-art.js (also shipped) already renders every alpha/frontier/signature card into renders/cards-composited/<slug>.svg via art-briefs.md. But build-site.js's discoverSourceFiles() only walks design/**/*.md and gamePlan.md, and serve-site.js's resolveFilePath() only serves paths under site/ — renders/cards-composited/ is never read by either script, so opening a card's page on the phone today shows the exact same raw markdown text you'd get from GitHub, not the actual composited artwork. Three already-shipped pieces (authoring engine, art compositing, phone site) exist but were never wired together at the one point RouterBox actually looks.
expected_outcome: Running node tools/composite-card-art.js then node tools/build-site.js and opening site/design/cards/alpha-set.html (or frontier-set.html / character-signatures.html) in a browser shows an element sourced from a site/-local copy of that card's renders/cards-composited/.svg, positioned immediately after that card's heading, for every card with a composited render; node --test is green.
intent:
tools/build-site.js (shipped) renders design/cards/*.md pages by feeding the raw markdown through renderMarkdown()/renderBlocks(), which only ever produces headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables from the source text — it has no awareness of renders/cards-composited/, the output directory tools/composite-card-art.js (shipped) already fills with one .svg per card named in design/cards/art-briefs.md, using the same slugify() from lib/parse-card-markdown.js that this unit will reuse to compute matching filenames. tools/serve-site.js (shipped) only serves files whose resolved path stays inside SITE_DIR (site/), so any image reference has to live under site/, not point out to renders/ directly. This unit changes build-site.js so that when it renders a page under design/cards/, for each level-3 (###) card-name heading it emits, if a matching renders/cards-composited/.svg exists on disk, the build (a) copies that SVG's current bytes into a site/-local path (e.g. site/_card-art/.svg) as part of the same build, and (b) inserts an immediately after that card's rendered

pointing at the copy, with a relative href computed the same way buildNav() already computes cross-page relative hrefs. Cards with no composited render yet (most of frontier-set.md and character-signatures.md, per the still-open art-briefs-frontier-signatures proposal) get no image and no broken reference — build-site.js must not throw when a card's SVG is simply absent. No card file, art-briefs.md, render-card.js, or composite-card-art.js is touched; this only changes how build-site.js turns already-existing composited output into something the shipped phone site actually shows.

criteria.text: For every card whose name (from a design/cards/*.md '###' heading) matches a file renders/cards-composited/.svg (slug computed via lib/parse-card-markdown.js's slugify, the same function tools/composite-card-art.js uses to name its output), running node tools/build-site.js produces a site/ page containing an tag whose src, resolved relative to that page's own output path, points at an existing file inside site/ whose bytes are byte-identical to the source renders/cards-composited/.svg.

For a card with no matching file in renders/cards-composited/, the generated page for that card's source file contains no tag referencing that card, and node tools/build-site.js exits 0 (does not throw) when some or all cards in a page lack a composited render.

Every copied site/-local card-art SVG file lives at a path under site/ that tools/serve-site.js's resolveFilePath() (from test/build-site.test.js's existing SITE_DIR-containment convention) would resolve and serve successfully, i.e. no card-art is an absolute filesystem path or a path that escapes site/.

Running node tools/composite-card-art.js then node tools/build-site.js twice in a row produces a byte-identical site/ tree (including the copied card-art SVGs) on the second run as the first, and every existing assertion in test/build-site.test.js against pages for non-card sections (World, Races, Characters, Rules, Plans & Ideas) still passes unchanged.
